title: Hypersurfaces of $\mathbb{H}^2\times\mathbb{H}^2$ with constant sectional curvature
summary: In this paper, we classify the hypersurfaces of $\mathbb{H}^2\times\mathbb{H}^2$ with constant sectional curvature. In contrast to $\mathbb{S}^2\times\mathbb{S}^2$, the resulting examples for $\mathbb{H}^2\times\mathbb{H}^2$ exhibit more diversity, and we construct a special example with non-constant product angle function. For $\mathbb{S}^2\times\mathbb{S}^2$, however, the product angle function of any constant sectional curvature hypersurface is identically zero.
